snippet.title: Hillthorn  |  Announcement Trailer  |  Play Demo Today!
snippet.description:
A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game that invites you to uncover the mystery without a single word spoken, using your skills of logic and intuition through cards.  

Wishlist Now and Play the Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3504050/_Hillthorn/
